metadata.title: The Love-Charm Tea Backfired at 3AM
metadata.subtitle: His cunning PR director brewed forbidden obedience tea to steal his shares—then accidentally drank the wrong thermos when the lights went out.

nodes.text: 1:48 AM · Typhoon wind rattles the 30th-floor executive lounge of Apex Tower. The main grid flickers out, plunging the pantry into pitch black.
Ms. {{player_name}}, backup power is kicking in on Floor 30—weirdly, I just caught Rachel on thermal cam pouring dark herbal powder into Mr. Ethan’s matte-black thermos!
Hold on—didn’t Rachel buy the exact same matte-black thermos for herself last week? Which one did she grab when the lights cut out?
OMG... the pantry counter bumped in the dark and she swapped them by accident! She just gulped down half of her OWN spiked thermos!!
Ugh why does my oolong taste like burnt cloves and ash?! Wait—Ethan, I’m sending over the 15% equity transfer memo for your signature tonight.

nodes.prompt: You realize Rachel brewed an illicit "obedience-charm" herbal tea meant for Ethan:

options.label: Ask Ethan not to touch his thermos
options.player_reply_text: Ethan, do NOT drink from the thermos on your desk—and watch the executive group chat closely for the next hour.

options.label: Have Toby lock chat message deletion
options.player_reply_text: Toby, enable compliance archive mode on the corporate chat server right now—every unsent message gets mirrored to the board log.

nodes.text: Copy that, {{player_name}}. Wait—why is Rachel typing nonstop in the all-hands board channel at 2 AM?!
Compliance mirror is LIVE, Ms. {{player_name}}! Nothing Rachel types tonight can ever vanish.
2:02 AM · The empty conference room glass fogs over. Rachel stares at her own thumbs—typing furious confessions she cannot stop.

nodes.headline: The Backfire Begins
nodes.teaser_text: Next: At 3:00 AM, Rachel’s own hands confess every dirty secret straight to the CEO.

nodes.text: 3:00 AM · Lightning flashes outside Floor 30. Rachel tries to drop her phone—yet her fingers stay glued to the glass, typing out loud in the executive group.
CONFESSION #1: I paid two gossip bloggers $40,000 last month to smear {{player_name}}’s product launch so Ethan would demote her!!
STOP!! Why am I typing this?! My fingers won’t obey me—someone is whispering in my ear telling me to confess EVERYTHING!!
Rachel?! You’re the one who leaked our launch deck to the tabloids?! I almost blamed {{player_name}}’s design team!

nodes.prompt: Rachel frantically taps "Unsend"—only for the compliance bot to repost it in bold:

options.label: Ask what else she brewed in that tea
options.player_reply_text: Old-world obedience charms always reverse on the brewer if the cup switches hands, Rachel. What else did you steal from Apex?

options.label: Ask Toby to check who met Rachel in the lobby
options.player_reply_text: Toby, rewind the lobby security camera from 11:30 PM. Who handed Rachel that herbal packet?

nodes.text: CONFESSION #2: I inflated the Q3 media-buy invoices by $620,000 and split the kickbacks with Nova Agency!! HELP ME I CAN’T STOP!!
Found it! Pulling the lobby CCTV snapshot right now—you’re going to recognize the guy in the trench coat!
CONFESSION #3: I also forged Ethan’s digital signature on the 15% PR-equity addendum stored in my locker!

nodes.headline: Three Confessions in Five Minutes
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Lobby CCTV reveals who supplied Rachel’s forbidden tea—and who wants Apex ruined.

nodes.text: 3:12 AM · Toby sends the timestamped lobby CCTV still into the executive channel while typhoon rain slams the windows.

nodes.caption: Look by the south pillar, Ms. {{player_name}}. That’s Damon—VP of our rival firm—handing Rachel a sealed brown envelope.

nodes.text: Damon?! Our direct competitor?! Rachel, you’ve been feeding our product roadmap to Damon while pretending to be my loyal PR director?!
He promised me a $2M signing bonus if I got Ethan to sign the 15% equity split tonight!! Someone please lock my phone—I’m freezing!!

nodes.prompt: Rachel’s voice note cuts in over the humming conference room lights:

options.label: Ask who is whispering in the room
options.player_reply_text: Listen closely, Rachel. The charm you drank was brewed to force absolute obedience—to the truth.

options.label: Send Ethan straight to Locker 14
options.player_reply_text: Ethan, head to the PR lounge Locker 14 right now with building security. Get that forged equity addendum before Damon’s courier arrives.

nodes.transcript: [chattering teeth, eerie whisper in background] "It keeps repeating: OPEN LOCKER 14! OPEN LOCKER 14! I don’t want to go to jail!"

nodes.text: On my way down the corridor now! Security has the master key.

nodes.headline: Locker 14
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Inside Locker 14, Ethan discovers a forged contract—and a live call from Damon.

nodes.text: 3:24 AM · Ethan unlocks Locker 14. Inside sits a freshly printed 15% equity transfer with a forged e-signature stamp—and a burner phone buzzing nonstop.
I just answered Rachel’s burner on mute—Damon yelled: "Did Ethan drink the tea yet?! Bring the signed shares down to the garage!"
He’s sitting in our own parking garage right now? Toby, drop the garage exit gates and call the commercial crimes unit.
Garage barriers locked! And the conference room door where Rachel is sitting just clicked shut—she’s still confessing to the webcam!

nodes.prompt: Ethan asks how you want to trap Damon in the garage:

options.label: Let police take him at the exit gate
options.player_reply_text: Don’t go down alone, Ethan. Police are six minutes away—let them pull Damon out of his sedan with the burner call log active.

options.label: Send Rachel’s live confession to Damon’s board
options.player_reply_text: Toby, forward the timestamped lobby CCTV and the burner recording to Damon’s general counsel as soon as officers cuff him.

nodes.text: Smart call. Security is watching his license plate from the booth.
Queued and ready to send, Ms. {{player_name}}! Their stock is going to crater by breakfast.

nodes.headline: Trapped in Level B2
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Ethan scans the forged equity contract—revealing how close Rachel came to stealing Apex.

nodes.text: 3:38 AM · Ethan lays the forged equity addendum under the desk lamp and uploads a clear scan for the corporate attorneys.

nodes.caption: Look at the counterfeit seal on page two, {{player_name}}. If she hadn’t grabbed the wrong thermos in the dark, she’d have tried to drug me into signing the witness line.

nodes.text: Every trap she built snapped shut on her own fingers. How’s Rachel doing in the conference room?
My hands finally stopped typing... the cold whisper just vanished. Please, Ethan, don’t press felony charges—I’ll resign right now!

nodes.prompt: Detectives step off the elevator onto Floor 30:

options.label: Hand over the thermos and forged contract
options.player_reply_text: Too late for resignations, Rachel. Detectives are taking the spiked thermos for toxicology and the forged equity contract into evidence.

options.label: Freeze Rachel’s PR vendor accounts
options.player_reply_text: Toby, freeze Nova Agency’s pending invoice payouts immediately so we recover every cent of those $620K kickbacks.

nodes.text: Update from the garage: Patrol units just cuffed Damon right beside his engine-running sedan!
All outgoing transfers halted! Treasury confirmed $620K stays safely in Apex’s account.

nodes.headline: Both Conspirators Cuffed
nodes.teaser_text: Next: With the storm clearing, Ethan makes a long-overdue apology to his co-founder.

nodes.text: 4:45 AM · Police escort Rachel and Damon out of Apex Tower. Outside, the typhoon clouds break into a calm pre-dawn sky.
{{player_name}}, I owe you an enormous apology. When those gossip blogs attacked your launch last month, I listened to Rachel’s spin instead of trusting you.
We built Apex from a two-desk garage, Ethan. Never let a smooth talker come between co-founders again.
Also—fun fact—I threw both matte-black thermoses in the biohazard bin. From now on everyone gets clear glass mugs!

nodes.prompt: Ethan laughs in relief and asks who should take over PR & Brand Strategy:

options.label: Lead the relaunch campaign myself
options.player_reply_text: I’ll oversee Brand Strategy until we hire someone with real integrity. And Toby gets a massive security bonus.

options.label: Lock dual-approval on all equity filings
options.player_reply_text: First thing at 9 AM: we amend the bylaws so no share transfer is valid without both founders’ biometric keys.

nodes.text: Yes!! Best night shift of my entire life!
Done. True 50-50 partners, locked in stone.

nodes.headline: Clear Glass Morning
nodes.teaser_text: Finale: Clear blue skies shine over Apex Tower as the relaunch hits #1.

nodes.text: 9:15 AM · Sunlight dazzles off the rain-washed skyline outside Floor 30. Inside the bright lounge, fresh coffee steams in clear glass mugs.
Look at the live press ticker, {{player_name}}—after the retraction from those blogs, our product pre-orders just tripled!
Turns out honesty is the best PR strategy after all.

nodes.prompt: You raise your clear glass mug toward the sunlit skyline:

options.label: Toast to clean coffee and loyal teammates
options.player_reply_text: Cheers to clear glass, clean ledgers, and zero midnight drama.

options.label: Share the launch bonus with the whole team
options.player_reply_text: Let’s split the recovered $620K media budget as a thank-you bonus for every engineer and designer.

nodes.text: Laughter rings through the sunlit office as the new product dashboard climbs to #1.
Cheers erupt across Floor 30—the brightest morning Apex Tower has ever seen.

nodes.headline: Truth Served Hot
nodes.teaser_text: You finished "The Love-Charm Tea Backfired at 3AM"! Explore more karma thrillers.
